What is measured of the extrapolation, in the workspace record (WORKSPACE-EXPERIMENTS-2026-09-10, W-5): the six-tool readout through the lens at the action position agrees with the model's own argmax where it resolves, by prompt-length band (<= 1,024 / <= 2,048 / > 2,048 tokens), at 0.99 / 0.99 / 0.98 from layer 24 and 0.92 to 1.00 through layer 33, with no band dependence from layer 24; below layer 24 the readout is unresolved at the 0.001 floor in every band, so no agreement is measured there. That measurement licenses the lens as a readout of the six tool logits at the action position from layer 24 on these contexts, and nothing else: a residual-space A2 reading at any layer below 24, and any reading at the note position, is outside measured validity and is reported as such; a dictionary-direction reading (A1) crosses no capture path. The cross-path term between the fit's width and the capture's width is the registered pairing beside each cell, not part of this statement.
